stable.label: ecosystem-hydro25-tested
stable.note: The existing multi-creature ecosystem remains the main experience. hydro_geomorph25 has local causal tests only until GitHub Actions runs the new test. The deployed browser/iPhone route after this change remains unverified.

active_experience.current_change: shift focus from creature-tech-demo presentation to a deeper water/terrain substrate: pore moisture, compaction, root reinforcement, erosion, suspended sediment, deposition and bank collapse
simulation_changes: three persistent depth lanes store moisture and suspended sediment with conservative cross-depth seepage/exchange
middle depth lane is authoritative for existing 2D collision/material terrain; front/rear lanes are storage/coupling lanes rather than fake 3D collision
wet-sediment strength rises at intermediate moisture and falls when waterlogged
refined-water velocity and volume generate erosion shear against exposed dirt/sand/mud/ash
erosion removes persistent soil mass and can convert exhausted terrain cells into air/water
suspended sediment advects with refined-water direction and deposits into actual sand/mud cells when flow slows over support
plant root state reinforces nearby soil against erosion
waterlogged weak unsupported banks can slump into lower cells
creature contact with wet loose substrate adds drag/sink and compacts the contacted soil
plant water state slowly couples to local hydro moisture
a conservative fine-water pressure-relaxation/velocity-smoothing pass reduces single-cell chatter without changing total water mass
presentation_and_controls: hydro layer renders only visible consequences such as seep darkening/depositional shelves/root traces, never a debug grid
existing world-first mobile observer and sound toggle remain active
approximations: Sandcastle's exact implementation is not public; GENESIS does not claim to use its solver
hydro_geomorph25 is not CFD, SPH, FLIP, PBF, MPM or full 3D terrain physics
three depth lanes simulate storage and exchange, but only the middle lane owns collision/material terrain
fine-water solver remains a conservative cellular/finite-volume-like approximation with damped momentum proxy
bank collapse is a local stability rule, not continuum soil mechanics
creature locomotion still contains legacy authored body drive

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

active_objective: Run independent CI for hydro_geomorph25, then exercise the deployed ecosystem on iPhone and inspect whether water settles more smoothly and visibly carves/deposits terrain without unstable bank flicker or frame-time spikes.
next_gate: hydro_geomorph25 can move from TESTED to CI_PASS only after GitHub Actions runs tests/hydro_geomorph25.test.mjs successfully and FORGE accepts the updated phase. LIVE_TESTED still requires actual deployed-browser execution.
invariants: The ecosystem sandbox is the primary user-facing experience
Do not claim Sandcastle's private solver or copy its game design
hydro_geomorph25 must not be called CFD/full 3D
Water visuals must remain derived from simulation state
Erosion/deposition claims require terrain state changes, not decals
CI_PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
